# Kotlin

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from kotlin/lang.json and kotlin/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

This page helps you build, test and check Kotlin code with rules_dx.

## Quick start

`MODULE.bazel` sits at the root of your repository and lists the Bazel modules, meaning external dependencies, that your project uses. Add `rules_dx` to it:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

Then let dx set up the rest, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart):

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//dx/launch:dx -- init --apply
```

For a Kotlin project, `MODULE.bazel` then looks like this:

```python
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

A `BUILD.bazel` file declares targets: the libraries, binaries and tests that Bazel builds. This one is a small Kotlin package from [`kotlin/tests/consumer`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/kotlin/tests/consumer/BUILD.bazel):

```python
load("@rules_dx//kotlin:defs.bzl", "kotlin_library", "kotlin_test")

kotlin_library(
    name = "my_project",
    srcs = ["Greet.kt"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)

kotlin_test(
    name = "greet_test",
    size = "small",
    srcs = ["GreetTest.kt"],
    test_class = "consumer.GreetTest",
    deps = [":my_project"],
)
```

Build and test everything. `//...` means every target in the repository:

```sh
tools/dx test //...
```

## Dependencies

### Internal members

To use the `internal` members of a `kotlin_library`, list it in `associates`.
The target then joins the Kotlin module of that library:

```python
kotlin_library(
    name = "greet_testing",
    srcs = ["GreetTesting.kt"],
    associates = [":greet"],
)
```

### Third-party dependencies

List the artifacts in a rules_jvm_external `maven_install.json` and run
`dx generate --apply`. It writes the targets and their `deps`. Each artifact
is the label `@maven//:<group>_<artifact>`, with dots and dashes turned into
underscores, for example `@maven//:com_google_guava_guava`. See
[generate](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/docs/cli/commands/generate.md).

### Writing targets

Warnings fail the build unless a target turns that off.

`kotlin_test` works out `test_class` from the sources and the package path.
Set it to override. Other attributes pass through to `kt_jvm_library`,
`kt_jvm_binary` and `kt_jvm_test`.

## Quality

| Check | Default tools |
| --- | --- |
| Format | `ktfmt` |
| Lint | `detekt`, `typos` |
| Typecheck | `kotlinc` |

None of them needs a config file.

## Bench and fuzz

`kotlin_fuzz_test` builds a Jazzer fuzz target for `dx fuzz`, like
`java_fuzz_test`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//kotlin:defs.bzl", "kotlin_fuzz_test")

kotlin_fuzz_test(
    name = "parse_fuzz",
    srcs = ["ParseFuzz.kt"],
    target_class = "pkg.ParseFuzz",
)
```

The target class needs a static `fuzzerTestOneInput(data: ByteArray)`. Put it
in an `object` and mark it `@JvmStatic`.

`kotlin_bench` runs JMH benchmarks for `dx bench`, like `java_bench`.

## Rules

`load` brings rules into a `BUILD.bazel` file. Load the ones you use from `@rules_dx//kotlin:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//kotlin:defs.bzl", "kotlin_library", "kotlin_binary", "kotlin_test")
```

### `kotlin_library`

```python
kotlin_library(name, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over kt_jvm_library.

### `kotlin_binary`

```python
kotlin_binary(name, *, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over kt_jvm_binary. Warnings are errors unless warnings_as_errors is False.

### `kotlin_test`

```python
kotlin_test(name, *, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Wraps kt_jvm_test with the dx test runner and warnings as errors.

### `kotlin_bench`

```python
kotlin_bench(name, *, srcs, deps = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

Runs the JMH benchmarks in Kotlin srcs and writes dx-bench.json for dx bench.

### `kotlin_fuzz_test`

```python
kotlin_fuzz_test(name, *, srcs = None, target_class = None, deps = None, visibility = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

A Jazzer fuzz target plus a `<name>_run` runner for `dx fuzz`.

### `kotlin_doc_shard`

```python
kotlin_doc_shard(name, lib, package = "", deps = [], **kwargs)
```

Declares the DocIr shard of one Kotlin library.

## Tools and package files

dx runs these tools and reads these package files for Kotlin:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tools | `detekt`, `kotlinc`, `ktfmt` |
| Ecosystems | maven |
| Manifests | `libs.versions.toml` |
| Lockfiles | `maven_install.json` |

## Platforms

Kotlin builds and tests on:

- Linux arm64
- Linux x86_64
- macOS arm64
- Windows arm64
- Windows x86_64

See the [support matrix](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/docs/support-matrix.md).

## API docs

`tools/dx docs` builds the API docs with `dokka`; see [docs](../cli/commands/docs.md).

To declare a docs target yourself, load the rule behind it:

```python
load("@rules_dx//kotlin:defs.bzl", "kotlin_doc_shard")
```
